outlet: Whitman County Gazette, 'Endicott voters facing six tax levies' (Teresa Simpson, 2024-10-24)
notes: Paywalled excerpt: Mayor Dean Marty said the 2024 measures would not fund major new projects; 2024 Fire and EMT Protection levy $12,000 at 47 cents per $1,000, paying for services from the local fire district; 2024 street work and maintenance levy $30,000 at an estimated $1.14 or less per $1,000. (The park levy amount is past the paywall.)
